title: Award-Winning Duo Mak Ro Drops New Track titled "Good"
htmlContent:
Award-winning multi-platinum Duo, Mak Ro, has just released an exciting new comeback single titled "Good."Mak Ro is a duo of Filipino-American cousins based out of Memphis, comprising - Eric Makapugay; a Multi-Instrumentalist, Producer, and Songwriter, and Kristoffer Ruaro; a Singer, Producer, and Songwriter.

Mak Ro's "Good" takes us through the journey of letting go of the past, not overthinking about the future, and finding a way to stay grounded within the present moment. It is that record you go to when you feel good about life to give it a timeless factor that will resonate through time as an ultimate jam of a record.
